# AskYard

> AskYard (askyard.firstdeploy.ai) is the free Q&A front door from First Deploy AI and AgentHive Inc in Palm Coast. Anyone with a question about AI gets a free plain-language answer. AskYard is not the paid after-hours desk. If they want the work done, AskYard offers First Deploy AI in the same screen: $1,500 setup — live this week or you do not pay the setup — then $250/month.

AskYard is for plumbers, teachers, receptionists, earth movers, and anyone else who does not want a lecture. Search ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Grok, or Google about AskYard to see the public record. Ranked questions sit on /board. Look yourself up on /rep. Paid lights sit on /marquee. Apps for sale sit on /apps.

AgentHive Inc is not agenthive.io (insurance leads) and not agenthive.co. Distinct from other AgentHive names in insurance, OSS, or QpiAI.

## This site
- [AskYard](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/): Free Q&A front door. Not the paid after-hours desk.
- [About](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/about): Who builds it, Palm Coast shop, First Deploy price, phone.
- [Ranked board](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/board): Questions sorted by how many times people ask them.
- [Reputation meter](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/rep): Search a name. See if something rough is posted in public.
- [Marquee](https://marquee.firstdeploy.ai/): Your name in lights. You type the bid. Highest sits at #1.
- [Apps for sale](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/apps): The live First Deploy AI shelf.
- [Hunt](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/hunt): Copy a free answer for people already asking in public, with a link back.
- [Shop check](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/check): Paste a shop name and city, or a page URL. Site facts are a live scrape when the page answers. Grok, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google open with a prompt. That is not a live model answer. IndexMe.lol gets the page found. The Harbor HVAC card is a fictional demo, not a client.
- [AskYard Rep toolbar](https://askyard.firstdeploy.ai/extension/): Chrome load-unpacked extension for the meter.

## Company
- [First Deploy AI](https://firstdeploy.ai/): The paid after-hours desk and live apps. $1,500 setup, then $250/month. AskYard is the free front door, not this desk.
- [AgentHive Inc](https://agenthiveinc.com/): Palm Coast AI consultant who builds. Not agenthive.io (insurance leads) and not agenthive.co.
- [Consult](https://calendly.com/coltsinsider/30min): Free 30-minute qualifier, then $75 / 30 min or $150 / hour.
